planets.name: Mercury
planets.description: The smallest planet and closest to the Sun, with extreme temperature swings.
fun_facts: A year on Mercury is only 88 Earth days
Mercury has the most extreme temperature swings in the solar system
A day on Mercury lasts 59 Earth days

planets.name: Venus
planets.description: The hottest planet with a thick toxic atmosphere and crushing pressure.
fun_facts: Venus rotates backwards compared to most planets
A day on Venus is longer than its year
Surface temperature can melt lead

planets.name: Earth
planets.description: Our home planet, the only known world with liquid water on its surface.
fun_facts: Earth is the only planet not named after a god
71% of Earth's surface is covered by water
Earth's rotation is gradually slowing down

planets.name: Mars
planets.description: The Red Planet, a cold desert world with the largest volcano in the solar system.
fun_facts: Olympus Mons on Mars is 3x taller than Mt. Everest
Mars has the largest dust storms in the solar system
A day on Mars is called a 'sol' and is slightly longer than an Earth day

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.description: The largest planet, a gas giant with a famous Great Red Spot storm.
fun_facts: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a storm larger than Earth
Jupiter has the shortest day of all planets
Jupiter acts as a cosmic vacuum cleaner, protecting inner planets from asteroids

planets.name: Saturn
planets.description: The ringed planet, famous for its spectacular ring system made of ice and rock.
fun_facts: Saturn's rings are mostly made of ice particles
Saturn is the least dense planet - it would float in water
Saturn has 146 known moons

planets.name: Uranus
planets.description: An ice giant that rotates on its side, with faint rings.
fun_facts: Uranus rotates on its side, likely due to an ancient collision
Uranus is the coldest planetary atmosphere in the solar system
Uranus was the first planet discovered using a telescope

planets.name: Neptune
planets.description: The windiest planet, an ice giant with the strongest sustained winds.
fun_facts: Neptune has the strongest winds in the solar system (2,100 km/h)
Neptune was predicted mathematically before being observed
A year on Neptune lasts 165 Earth years

planets.name: Pluto
planets.description: A dwarf planet in the Kuiper Belt with a heart-shaped nitrogen glacier.
fun_facts: Pluto was reclassified from planet to dwarf planet in 2006
Pluto has a heart-shaped glacier called Tombaugh Regio
Pluto's largest moon, Charon, is half its size
